## Activity

During November 2018, Market Eye Clinic recorded 375 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance. The activity level should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the subsequent grading outcomes.

## Image quality

A total of 9 captures were marked ungradable, equivalent to an ungradable rate of 2.4 per cent. This result should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that equipment-related concerns can be tracked and reviewed consistently.

## Grading

There were 56 referable results among the captures completed during November 2018. The median grading lag was 6. This provides an overview of the time taken for grading during the reporting period and should be read with the activity and image-quality measures above. Ongoing attention to capture quality and prompt reporting of camera issues will support reliable grading and help maintain consistent service delivery at Market Eye Clinic.
